newsitem.title: UK: Britain to send experts to help in Peru crisis.
newsitem.headline: Britain to send experts to help in Peru crisis.

text.p: Britain said on Thursday it would send experts to help Peruvian authorities trying to obtain the release of hundreds of hostages from the Japanese ambassador's residence in Lima.
"We are strengthening the (British) ambassador's team with a number of experts skilled in handling incidents like this one," said a Foreign Office spokeswoman.
"They are being sent to advise the ambassador and liaise as necessary with the Peruvian authorities."
Britain's ambassador to Lima had attended the party but left before guerrillas began their spectacular assault late on Tuesday. One senior British diplomat is among the hostages.

The spokeswoman declined to say whether the experts were members of the crack Special Air Service (SAS) unit, who in 1980 successfully stormed the Iranian embassy in London where six guerrillas were holding 21 people hostage.
Five guerrillas died in the shoot-out, which unfurled in full view of the television cameras. The guerrillas killed two civilians but the SAS troops rescued 19 others.
